channel.title: Mikhbar — English
channel.description: Technology news covering AI, robotics, automation, mobile, computing, software, the web and digital platforms.

item.title: Liquid AI Unveils LFM3 Multimodal Model Family
item.description: Liquid AI introduces LFM3, a new generation of multimodal foundation models spanning text, vision, audio, omni, and decision capabilities on a 2B backbone.

item.title: iPhone Duo vs Pixel 11 Pro Fold: Foldable Flagship Comparison
item.description: Compare Apple's iPhone Duo and the Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold across screens, cameras, design, and performance to see how these foldables differ.

item.title: Apple Releases iOS 27.2 With New Siri AI Languages
item.description: Apple has launched iOS 27.2 for iPhones and iPads, introducing new Siri AI languages, memory updates, and security patches.

item.title: Exowatt Beats Frontier Models with SageMaker AI Customization
item.description: Exowatt leverages Amazon SageMaker AI serverless model customization to build high-accuracy fine-tuned models at up to 49x lower cost.

item.title: Fixing Evaluation Bias Unlocks Better Models on Amazon Bedrock
item.description: Property Finder discovered that 96.8% of vision-AI labels were inherited from an incumbent model, skewing results before shifting to Amazon Bedrock.

item.title: OpenAI and Oracle Expand Partnership to Bring Apps to ChatGPT
item.description: OpenAI and Oracle expand their commercial partnership to integrate business applications and AI agents into ChatGPT and power new Oracle offerings.

item.title: Google DeepMind Unveils Genie 4 World Simulation Model
item.description: Google DeepMind introduces Genie 4, a new real-time interactive world simulation model featuring native audio, advanced physics, and Gemini integration.

item.title: Meta Details PrivacyLib for Data Access Boundary Controls
item.description: Meta detailed PrivacyLib, a client library designed to enforce privacy rules at data access boundaries across hundreds of backend systems.

item.title: Microsoft Details Platform Approach to Frontier Transformation
item.description: Explore Microsoft's platform approach to Frontier Transformation, highlighting enterprise adoption stories across Volkswagen, Fujitsu, NASA, and more.

item.title: Smart Window Adds Form Filling and Page Watching Features
item.description: Mozilla's Smart Window beta introduces new AI browsing features, including intelligent form filling and automated web page watching tasks.

item.title: Cloudflare Launches PHP Capture the Flag Challenge on HackerOne
item.description: Cloudflare has introduced a PHP Capture the Flag challenge integrated with its Bug Bounty program to test WAF protections against recent vulnerabilities.

item.title: C-BRAIN and NVIDIA Deploy Open Source AI Tools for Dementia
item.description: Discover how C-BRAIN is collaborating with NVIDIA to deploy open source AI tools and accelerate research for millions living with dementia.

item.title: Apple Unveils New 14-Inch MacBook Pro and iMac with M6 Chip
item.description: Apple has announced its new 14-inch MacBook Pro and refreshed iMac lineup, both powered by the latest M6 chip, featuring Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 support.

item.title: Apple Updates 14-Inch MacBook Pro with M6 Chip
item.description: Apple has refreshed the entry-level 14-inch MacBook Pro with the new M6 processor, featuring faster graphics, Wi-Fi 7, and advanced AI capabilities.

item.title: Firefox Details Recent Hidden Features and Roadmap Updates
item.description: Mozilla highlights recent Firefox browser improvements alongside upcoming features on its public roadmap, including Mini Window and offline mode.

item.title: Apple Unveils New iMac Featuring the M6 Chip
item.description: Apple has announced a new iMac powered by the M6 chip, bringing improved performance, advanced on-device AI capabilities, and Wi-Fi 7 to the all-in-one desktop.

item.title: Apple Introduces 14-Inch MacBook Pro Powered by M6
item.description: Apple has announced the new 14-inch MacBook Pro featuring the M6 chip, delivering enhanced on-device AI capabilities and up to 24 hours of battery life.

item.title: Apple Announces Major Creator Studio Updates With New AI Features
item.description: Apple introduces sweeping updates to Apple Creator Studio, bringing advanced AI features, MotionVFX integration, and new tools across its app suite.

item.title: Instagram Expands Long-Form Video and TV Viewing Features
item.description: Instagram is updating its platform to support 90-minute videos, horizontal viewing, and TV integration to capture the expanding clip and streaming economy.

item.title: Microsoft adds Intel APX support to Windows 11 Insider
item.description: Microsoft is preparing for future processors by introducing an early Advanced Performance Extensions setting for Windows 11 Insiders.

item.title: Anthropic Details Runaway AI Risks in IPO Filing
item.description: Artificial intelligence giant Anthropic has detailed potential risks, including runaway AI and malicious weapons development, in an SEC filing.

item.title: Nvidia Backs Indian Startup Simplismart in $14M Funding Round
item.description: Nvidia participates in a $14 million Series B funding round for Indian startup Simplismart, supporting software that helps companies run AI models efficiently.

item.title: GM Product Chief Details Tech Roadmap and AI Strategy
item.description: General Motors Chief Product Officer Sterling Anderson discusses the automaker's ambitious shift toward artificial intelligence, centralized computing, and software-driven vehicle development.

item.title: Media Outlets Turn to AI Agents as a New Target Audience
item.description: Publishers explore AI-focused content feeds, data-driven structures, and reader tools tailor-made for artificial intelligence agents.

item.title: Apple Backports CoreGraphics Zero-Day Patches to Older Devices
item.description: Apple has backported security patches for a CoreGraphics zero-day vulnerability to older iPhone and iPad models following targeted attacks.

item.title: Data Center Gear Hijacked in Transit Totaling Millions
item.description: Organized crime syndicates are hijacking high-value data center equipment in transit, utilizing hacks, GPS spoofing, and vehicle ramming.

item.title: Data Center Backlash Unites Voters Across US Midterms
item.description: The rapid buildout of massive data centers and infrastructure expenses spark local opposition and become a major issue in congressional and gubernatorial campaigns.

item.title: Testing Major AI Agents: Performance, Pricing, and Features
item.description: An evaluation of major personal AI agents highlights their capabilities, varying monthly prices, and performance across daily tasks.

item.title: Why iPhone Duo Buyers Should Avoid Skipping AppleCare
item.description: Discover why purchasing AppleCare+ or AppleCare One is a virtual necessity for the costly iPhone Duo to protect against high repair fees.

item.title: Even Realities Launches Brown G2 Smart Glasses and Accessories
item.description: Even Realities has expanded its G2 smart glasses lineup with a new Even Brown 2 colorway, alongside new wearable chain and sunglasses clip accessories.

item.title: OpenAI Announces New Math, Physics and Computer Science Discoveries
item.description: OpenAI unveils new discoveries in math, physics, and computer science, including models generating proof that the Exponential Time Hypothesis is false.

item.title: CISA Confirms Active Exploitation of PHP2Shell Flaws
item.description: CISA adds critical PHP2Shell vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog and orders federal agencies to patch systems quickly.

item.title: Android Auto Gaming Support Officially Launches for Cars
item.description: Android Auto now supports in-car gaming while parked. Discover which games are available, how to install them, and how safety measures work.

item.title: Instagram Pushes Into Longform and Widescreen Video With Features
item.description: Instagram is introducing a new longform horizontal video format called Features, shifting its strategy to compete with platforms like YouTube.

item.title: Maritime Coalition Launches Free Vulnerability Database
item.description: A coalition of maritime and cybersecurity organizations has launched the Blue Initiative, a free public database indexing nearly 30,000 IT and OT vulnerabilities.

item.title: Grok Admits Its AI Odyssey Adaptation Is Not Accurate
item.description: Months after Elon Musk vowed that xAI would produce a historically accurate version of The Odyssey, the chatbot itself has admitted defeat.

item.title: Apple Announces Upgraded iPad Mini With OLED Display and A20 Pro
item.description: Apple has announced a new iPad Mini featuring a larger 8.5-inch OLED display, an upgraded A20 Pro chip, and a starting price of $699.

item.title: OpenAI Announces Three Major Science Discoveries with Academics
item.description: OpenAI unveils three new discoveries in math, computer science, and physics, working alongside external academic experts and advisors.

item.title: Bedrock Robotics Raises $600M to Expand Self-Driving Excavators
item.description: Autonomous vehicle startup Bedrock Robotics has secured a $600 million funding round, bringing its valuation to $4.1 billion as it scales operations.

item.title: Google Photos Rolls Out Customizable Collections Tab Redesign
item.description: Google Photos for Android is rolling out a major redesign of the Collections tab with customizable features, new carousels, and reordering options.
